svg.text: The Node 1 v1.1 page in a phone browser (illustration)
HTML from network.cpp, rendered at phone-screen width · the readings and addresses are only examples
link to /on: the lamp relay turns on
link to /off: the lamp relay turns off
The address can be the .local name (laptop, iPhone)
or the fixed IP address from Practice 9, for example
